message: No detected untrusted source handling: BERT model is loaded via BertModel.from_pretrained and BertTokenizer without any pinned revision, checksum verification, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code (GraphDataset, file_to_ids, etc.) reads triples and maps them to IDs without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a pretrained BERT model via `BertModel.from_pretrained(encoder_name, ...)` and uses `torch.load` for maps without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) integrated anywhere.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (MRR, Hits@K, filtered variants) are computed, there is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other explicit metric-tampering protections.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range validation, schema checks, or malformed-input rejection are present on the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The evaluation/inference code computes scores and embeddings without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a knowledge-graph link-prediction model using BERT for entity encoding, not an LLM text-in/text-out pipeline, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
